change.description: Add a signed GitHub Actions recovery entry point for failed Product Releases that already froze inputs but produced no products.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible release operations fix. It adds a narrowly scoped workflow that invokes the existing fail-closed recovery command without changing product endpoints, artifact formats, or application persistence.

current.reasoning: The new workflow accepts only one release identity, checks out main, grants only job-scoped contents and actions permissions, and delegates all run, artifact, source, and ledger validation to abandon-failed-inputs.

evidence.command: Workflow contract inspection confirms main checkout, one identity input, actions:read, contents:write, and the existing fail-closed recovery command.

scope_drift.description: The candidate is limited to the missing failed-input recovery workflow, its contract regression, and the corresponding release runbook procedure.

verified.reasoning: Focused workflow contract and formatting checks pass. The workflow cannot alter products or application state and uses the existing signed ledger update path through GitHub Actions.

evidence.command: The recovery workflow does not alter HTTP, tRPC, MCP, or shipped product contracts.

persistent_state.state_description: The workflow invokes the existing release ledger transition and does not change its schema, frozen artifact format, SQLite schema, or browser persistence.

evidence.command: Only the existing abandon-failed-inputs command can update the ledger, using the Actions bot signing path.
